opportunities.text: Agent capabilities should be protocols, not just prompts. Most AI tooling attempts to solve coding tasks through raw prompting. They treat the model as a magic box that should somehow just know how to navigate a build system or run a test suite. It is a brittle way to work. JetBrains is moving toward a structured mechanism instead. With the introduction of IntelliJ IDEA Agent Skills, the AI Assistant shifts from pure text generation to a system of discrete, manageable capabilities. This is built on the Agent Client Protocol (ACP). The mechanism is straightforward. Instead of hoping a model understands the nuances of a specific framework, the agent is given a skill. opportunities.title: Is social capital just a proxy for liquidity?
opportunities.text: Is social capital just a proxy for liquidity? A high density of social connections is not a direct driver of technological breakthroughs. A careless reading of the relationship between social capital and innovation suggests that simply increasing the number of people an inventor knows will catalyze new patent filings. This view treats social capital as a nebulous, qualitative force that somehow lowers the friction of idea exchange. The data in NBER Working Paper 35732 suggests a more mechanical, less mystical driver. The researchers find that the primary driver of innovation is Economic Connectedness (EC), which they define as the share of high-income friendships.
